storageCleanupDesc: See what Kun stores on this computer and clean up old content with your consent.
storageCleanupCatHint_worktrees: Git worktrees from tasks and plan builds
storageCleanupCatHint_agents: External agents, Android SDK, JDK, TUI runtime
storageCleanupCatHint_caches: Web cache, code cache, traces, logs
storageCleanupCatHint_attachments: Images, pasted files and the artifact library
storageCleanupCatHint_other: Index database, skills, settings and more
storageCleanupSafeDesc: Web and code caches, plus model call traces older than 14 days. They rebuild on their own; no conversation or file is touched.
storageCleanupAutoOff: Off. Turning it on lists what will be cleaned and asks you to confirm once.
storageCleanupAutoOn: On. You agreed to these rules on {{date}}.
storageCleanupAutoNeedsConsent: Paused: this setting cleans more than you agreed to. Confirm again to resume.
storageCleanupAgeDesc: Counted from the last update, not from creation. Pinned, running, room and active-goal conversations are always skipped.
storageCleanupRuleThreadsDesc: Slimmed: per-token replay and old background terminal output are removed. Messages stay, so the conversation still opens and can be searched.
storageCleanupRuleWorktreesDesc: Folders under worktrees/tasks with no files left. Worktrees that still hold code are never touched.
storageCleanupNotifyBeforeDesc: A notification shows the size; you can review or skip that run.
storageCleanupTrashDays: Keep removed files in the trash for
storageCleanupTrashDaysDesc: Slimmed replay logs are released right away and cannot be restored.
storageCleanupManualDesc: These can be downloaded again or need your judgment, so automatic cleanup leaves them alone.
storageCleanupManualHint_agentRuntimes: Remove an agent from Agents settings; it downloads again when used.
storageCleanupManualHint_toolchains: Only needed to build Android projects.
storageCleanupManualHint_indexDatabase: Search and list index. Kun maintains it.
storageCleanupManualHint_migrationBackup: Snapshots from settings and data migrations, older than 30 days. Credential backups are not included.
storageCleanupEmptyTrashConfirm: Delete everything in the trash now? This cannot be undone.
storageCleanupResultFailed: {{n}} items could not be cleaned and will be retried
storageCleanupConsentBody: Once a week, while the computer is idle, Kun cleans content not updated for {{days}} days. With today's data that frees about {{size}}.
storageCleanupConsentWontBody: Pinned, running, room and active-goal conversations; artifacts, attachments, skills, memory, settings and credentials; worktrees with code; your workspace files.
storageCleanupConsentAgree: I understand this content will be cleaned on a schedule
storageCleanupConsentReask: Shortening the age or adding a new kind of cleanup will ask you again.
storageCleanupReviewTitle: Content to clean · older than {{days}} days
storageCleanupReviewDesc: Unchecked items are skipped this time. Pin a conversation to keep it out for good.
storageCleanupReviewSkipped: Skipped automatically: {{pinned}} pinned, {{active}} running, {{room}} room, {{goal}} active-goal conversations.
storageCleanupReviewTruncated: Only the largest conversations are listed; the rest wait for the next run.
